term: caused composite has a caused proper part
definition: Every composite with an incoming G cause contains some proper part with an incoming G cause. Proper part is strict parthood, not simple part. No iteration termination or inference to a caused simple is built in.
note: Author Step1p127 combines P6 with P2 termination to obtain a caused simple. P6's defensep135 adds collective uncausedness, supplementation and composition-as-identity; none is a theorem of the bare order or assumed by the analyst minimum.
